Foreign aid is a corporate subsidy with strings attached.
IMF / World Bank
The Bait
Loans are provided to build corporate-friendly
infrastructure (ports, refineries) rather than
social infrastructure. Funds often bypass the
public, going to corrupt, compliant officials.
•The Trap
When debt becomes unpayable, the IMF
imposes a Structural Adjustment Program
(SAP).
The Extraction
SAPs mandate the privatization of state
assets (water, rail, mines), the elimination
of social subsidies, and the removal of
labor protections.
Foreign aid doesn't fail; it succeeds perfectly at
indenturing entire nations to global finance.

Thinking outside the paradigm
Stop asking why US policy is so stupid, short-sighted,
or clumsy. It is none of these things. It is a ruthlessly
rational, highly successful machine operating exactly
as intended by the plutocracy that designs it.
Reality is radical. The empire relies on the illusion of its
own benvolence. Recognizing the face of imperialism is
the first necessary act of intellectual self-defense.
